meta.title: HamsterLab
meta.description: Tiny hamsters. Twisty tubes. A big little adventure.
tagline.second: Twist the tubes. Bring your hamsters home.
native.eyebrow: THE LITTLE LAB OF BIG ADVENTURES
native.selectHint: Drag a platform to twist the tubes. Guide the hamsters to your home below.
native.selected: Platform {platform} is ready. Your twist stays secret until reveal!
native.gestureRule: Drag around a platform to turn it. Tap a platform to clear your planned turn. You can change your choice during the 30-second timer. Your hamster home is always at the bottom.
native.winRule: Bring seven hamsters home to win early. Otherwise the most hamsters after 30 rounds wins. Equal scores are a draw.
native.offline: Explore offline with a lab bot. It chooses its move before you do.
rules.board: The laboratory has nine rotating platforms, each holding four transparent tube sections.
rules.goal: Guide as many hamsters as possible to your home. Your home is always at the bottom.
rules.spawn: New hamsters enter from the two golden hatches on scheduled rounds.
rules.combine: Both secret twists are revealed together. Twists on the same platform combine.
rules.cooldown: A platform that turns must rest for one round.
lab.welcome: Welcome to HamsterLab! Let’s bring our tiny friends home.
lab.win: Squeak hooray! What a clever scientist!
lab.finish: A lovely experiment! Shall we try again?
native.privacyText:
HamsterLab does not use advertising, analytics, tracking, accounts, or in-app purchases.

Your nickname and preferences stay on your device. Online play sends your nickname, a random room credential and connection details to the HamsterLab signaling service. Your opponent sees your nickname and can receive your IP address through the direct WebRTC connection. Moves travel directly between the two players.

Waiting rooms and matches with an absent player expire after 30 minutes. Active rooms remain available. Infrastructure providers may retain technical request logs, including IP addresses, for security and service operation.

Recovery credentials and hidden moves are stored in the iOS Keychain on this device. Leaving an online game clears its recovery data. Sound and haptics can be disabled in Settings. Training works without an internet connection; an optional online-presence check may contact the signaling service.

No camera, microphone, contacts or location access is requested.

Publisher: Dzmitry Sharko. Support and privacy requests: https://twivvy.e-notix.com/support.html

Updated: 17 September 2026.
